name: Xintai
source: Xintai Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau is evidenced through official Taian municipal government material as a local real-estate-registration custodian; no anonymous public parcel feature service was verified.

queries.query: Xintai China official cadastral map parcel GIS Natural Resources Bureau
queries.result: Search identified official Taian Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material about Xintai real-estate registration, plus a non-government technical article describing Xintai's spatial-data platform. No public Xintai parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was found.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Taian Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau; Xintai Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official article states the Xintai bureau director conducted work at the Xintai government-service-center real-estate-registration window and describes registration service responsibilities. It does not publish parcel geometry or an API.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Taian Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Taian municipal cadastral/registration system guidance; county-level systems are supervised rather than directly exposed
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page says the registration system supports SHP vector cadastral data, uses CGCS2000 with 3-degree Gauss projection, and lists cadastral field examples. These are schema/context evidence, not a public Xintai feature response.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: SouthGIS technical publication; not a registry custodian
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Describes a Xintai natural-resources private-cloud spatial-data platform and broad thematic layers. It is general technical/vendor prose and does not provide an anonymous parcel endpoint; it is not used as registry proof.
